content.comment_body: Hello, I've been experimenting with the weekly timer function and noticed it's not possible to directly associate it with an input. With my rocker switch, I tried switching the power on and off, which interrupts the power, but the timer still activates regardless, which is acceptable. However, the display shows unwanted content, which isn't ideal. Is there any way to adjust the main screen to a layout I prefer instead of the standard date and time?

You can use an AND logic block to combine the weekly timer with an input. For display settings, go to file > properties > parameter and choose what the display shows after power on; the only options available are date-time or inputs-outputs. Alternatively, you can use a text message block to show custom information.

Thanks for the response. From what you describe, it doesn't seem possible unless I'm missing something. I read the manual and managed to adjust the start screen, but I just want a custom start screen rather than having to settle for the default date and time.
Check out the image provided; it might offer some guidance.
If a text message is enabled, that will be shown. The date and time or I/O information is displayed only when there's no text message active. Hope this clarifies things.

Hello everyone, Apologies for the late reply, I've been busy. Before you replied with your example, I spent a long time figuring things out, and managed to achieve what I wanted. My main issue now is trying to get it to work using just one output instead of two, since I'm using a three-way rocker switch (off - on - off) as an input. I'll definitely review your example and share my source file.

analysis.insight_summary: Users faced challenges connecting the weekly timer to inputs and found the display customization features limited, particularly with startup screen choices. There was some confusion regarding logic structuring in the programming software, making it less intuitive for newcomers.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect straightforward linking of hardware inputs like rocker switches to the weekly timer functionality, along with broader options to customize the main device display beyond preset templates.
